svg.text: Blood left on the world, in three tiers. Each asks more of you and does more.
docs/core_loop · proposal, nothing approved · design illustration, not in-game art
A few mL on any face. Rain washes it off, and Absorption
takes it back while it is wet.
A PULSE RUNS UP TO 64 BLOCKS
Cut into the block, and permanent. It lies dormant until
The Earthen Vein, extended. It carries blood between two
nodes for an upkeep. Unfed, it withers to a gouge.
ONE CATALYST IN A GOUGE DECIDES WHAT THE PULSE DOES
Absorption lifts the blood back out of any of them.
